basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast currently living in Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company. In my spare time, I enjoy gaming, especially competitive shooters like Escape from Tarkov and strategy games like The Binding of Isaac. I recently upgraded to a OnePlus 7 Pro, and I love customizing it, especially through CSS tweaks for Firefox. I'm new to Reddit and still exploring its various communities. When I'm not gaming or working, I like to unwind with a bit of idle gaming on Ulala: Idle Adventure. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for five years. My expertise mainly lies in software development and mobile technology, which I enjoy discussing and learning more about through online resources and community forums.
